title: Remove Timing Belt on Tipper Station (A-axis/counterbalance positioning, LOTO, side panel removal, belt access)
summary: Safely prepare the OptiSweep tipper station for timing belt replacement by manually positioning the A-axis/counterbalance between the actuator-base threaded holes, performing site “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” on the tipper, removing the nine (9) self-tapping side-panel fasteners to access the timing belt, and threading M6 socket-head screws into the holes below both carriages to prevent dropping once belt tension is released.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when preparing the tipper station for timing belt replacement and you must (1) position the A-axis/counterbalance correctly, (2) lock out/tag out the tipper using the site Operator Station LOTO process, (3) remove the station side panels to access the timing belt, and (4) install M6 socket-head screws below both carriages before releasing belt tension.
not_for: Do not proceed to belt tension release unless the M6 socket-head screws are threaded into the holes below both carriages to prevent dropping.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform on-site physical positioning, execute site Operator Station Lockout/Tagout for the tipper, remove side panels, and install the M6 socket-head screws as specified.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper using the site’s “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” process before removing side panels or accessing belt components.
Do not release belt tension unless the M6 socket-head screws are threaded into the holes below both carriages to prevent the A-axis/counterbalance from dropping.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper station

access_required: Physical access to the tipper station
system_preconditions: Tipper station is ready for maintenance access (side panels can be removed after LOTO).
external_references: Site “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” process (referenced by the manual as the required LOTO method).

visual_references.description: Timing Belt Replacement (7.3.8.1 REMOVAL) figure showing A-axis/counterbalance positioning between actuator-base threaded holes, side panel access, and M6 socket-head screws below both carriages.

steps.title: Manually position the A-axis and counterbalance between actuator-base threaded holes
steps.purpose: Place the A-axis/counterbalance in the correct safe position so the station side panels can be removed and the belt access/prevent-drop screws can be installed.
steps.instruction: Manually position the A-axis and the counterbalance between the threaded holes in the actuator base. There are two holes adjacent to each rail; position the carriages between the holes on the respective rails.
steps.expected_result: The A-axis and counterbalance carriages are positioned between the threaded holes on their respective rails (two holes adjacent to each rail).
steps.healthy_condition: Both carriages are visibly located between the threaded holes adjacent to each rail (not outside the hole pair).
steps.failure_condition: One or both carriages are not between the threaded holes on their respective rails.

actions.label: Position A-axis/counterbalance
actions.exact_action: Manually position the A-axis and the counterbalance between the threaded holes in the actuator base. There are two holes adjacent to each rail. The carriages should be positioned between the holes on the respective rails.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check positioning if the carriages are not between the threaded holes on their respective rails.

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the tipper using the site Operator Station Lockout/Tagout process
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely de-energized/locked out before removing side panels and accessing the timing belt area.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO on the tipper using the site’s “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” process.
steps.expected_result: The tipper is in a locked-out/tagged-out state per the site Operator Station Lockout/Tagout process.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is completed and verified for the tipper before proceeding to side panel removal.
steps.failure_condition: LOTO cannot be completed/verified for the tipper.

actions.label: Execute site LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not proceed if LOTO cannot be completed/verified for the tipper.

steps.title: Remove the nine (9) self-tapping side-panel fasteners and remove side panels to access the timing belt
steps.purpose: Expose the timing belt so the belt replacement preparation can continue.
steps.instruction: Use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the station side panels, then remove the station side panels to access the timing belt.
steps.expected_result: The nine (9) self-tapping side-panel fasteners are removed and the station side panels are off, exposing the timing belt access area.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panels are removed and the timing belt area is accessible without obstruction.
steps.failure_condition: Side panels remain secured (fasteners not fully removed) or timing belt access is obstructed.

actions.label: Remove side-panel fasteners
actions.exact_action: Use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panels then remove the station side panels to access the timing belt.

steps.title: Thread M6 socket-head screws into holes below both carriages to prevent dropping
steps.purpose: Mechanically prevent the A-axis and counterbalance from dropping when belt tension is released.
steps.instruction: Thread M6 socket-head screws into the holes below both carriages. These screws will prevent the A-axis and counterbalance from dropping once belt tension is released.
steps.expected_result: M6 socket-head screws are installed in the holes below both carriages.
steps.healthy_condition: Both sets of holes below the carriages have M6 socket-head screws threaded in place (prevent-drop condition established).
steps.failure_condition: M6 socket-head screws are not installed below one or both carriages.

actions.label: Install M6 prevent-drop screws
actions.exact_action: Thread M6 socket-head screws into the holes below both carriages. These screws will prevent the A-Axis and counterbalance from dropping once belt tension is released.

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not release belt tension unless the M6 socket-head screws are threaded into the holes below both carriages to prevent dropping.

success_criteria: A-axis and counterbalance are positioned between the actuator-base threaded holes with carriages between the holes on their respective rails.
Tipper is LOTO’d using the site Operator Station Lockout/Tagout process.
Nine (9) self-tapping side-panel fasteners are removed and side panels are off to access the timing belt.
M6 socket-head screws are threaded into the holes below both carriages to prevent dropping once belt tension is released.
healthy_conditions: Carriages are between the two threaded holes adjacent to each rail.
LOTO is completed/verified for the tipper before side panel removal.
Side panels are removed and timing belt access area is exposed.
M6 socket-head screws are installed below both carriages.
failure_conditions: Carriages are not between the threaded holes on their respective rails.
LOTO cannot be completed/verified for the tipper.
Side panels cannot be removed because the nine self-tapping fasteners are not fully removed.
M6 socket-head screws are missing below one or both carriages, making belt tension release unsafe.
escalation_guidance: If positioning is incorrect, stop and re-check carriage placement between the threaded holes on their respective rails before continuing.
If LOTO cannot be completed/verified for the tipper, stop and do not proceed.
If M6 socket-head screws cannot be installed below both carriages, stop and do not release belt tension.
